newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss Re names Speiser to post of CFO.
newsitem.headline: Swiss Re names Speiser to post of CFO.

text.p: Swiss Reinsurance Company said it had appointed Christian Speiser, currently chairman of Biber Holding AG, to its executive board effective March 1.

"In the following months, as chief financial officer, he will take over responsibility from Bruno Laube and Christoph Dorschel for corporate finance, investor relations, taxes, information technology, accounting, controlling and corporate accounting as well as strategic asset allocation," it said.
Laube and Dorschel are to retire at the end of 1997 and 1998, respectively.
Speiser also spent 14 years as a partner and advisor with McKinsey & Co, Swiss Re said. It added he had also spent a long period of time in Japan and Taiwan.
